name: Helmsman
power_text: Your Ease turns may be Hard turns, and the reverse.

name: Sailing Master
power_text: Close Hauled counts as Broad Reach for your sail moves.

name: Rigger
power_text: Once per turn, change your sail level by one step without a Sail card.

name: Storm Hand
power_text: You take no DD from Full Sail in a Gale.

name: Anchor Hand
power_text: You may ignore wind drift.
notes: Permanent version of the Wind Chimes equipment card.

name: Pilot
power_text: You may ignore one current each turn.
notes: Permanent version of the Ocean Charts equipment card.

name: Leadsman
power_text: Sandbanks and underwater reefs never strand you; you stop beside them instead.

name: Master Gunner
power_text: Cannon range 5 instead of 4.
notes: Permanent version of the Cannon Sights equipment card.

name: Bow Chaser
power_text: Your broadsides also hit the hex directly ahead.

name: Powder Monkey
power_text: Your Fire Cannons card counts +200 initiative.

name: Marksman
power_text: Once per turn, re-roll one damage die you dealt.

name: Ram Master
power_text: Your rams deal 2 DD instead of 1.

name: Boarding Chief
power_text: When you ram a treasure carrier, knock the treasure loose and still deal the DD.

name: Carpenter
power_text: Your Repair removes 2 damage markers.

name: Surgeon
power_text: Automatically heals 1 wounded crew member per turn.
notes: Power is already in rules 3.6; the creature and icons are ideas.

name: Bosun
power_text: Once per turn, ignore 1 Ship damage.

name: Cook
power_text: Wounded crew still draw their cards.
notes: Only useful if wounded crew normally draw nothing (rules Q48).

name: Bodyguard
power_text: Must take the first Crew damage each turn; your Captain can't be wounded while the Bodyguard is healthy.

name: Lookout
power_text: See one rival's programmed Part I cards before you lock in.

name: Cartographer
power_text: Each turn, trade in any two command cards for two new ones.
flavour_text: Her maps were more valuable than gold, although she still expected a heavy price.
notes: Designer's idea (2026-11-18). Icons not specified; 1 assumed. "Move cards" taken to mean command cards.

name: Chart Keeper
power_text: Peek at the top treasure map card.
notes: Renamed from Cartographer when the designer's Cartographer took that name. Rules 3.6 and 8.2.1 already reserve this power for some crew or equipment.

name: Navigator
power_text: When you enter a whirlpool, you may choose not to travel.

name: Diver
power_text: Search a wreck by passing through it; draw 2 and keep 1.

name: Quartermaster
power_text: Hand limit 10. No other power.

name: Monster Whisperer
power_text: +1 sea monster influence.
notes: The rare octopus-icon crew of rules 9.1.

name: Drunken Sailor
power_text: Starts incapacitated as you leave port.
notes: Designer's idea (2026-11-18): a mildly negative crew card. Icons not specified; 1 assumed. To decide: is incapacitated the wounded side, and does it apply at the start of the game only or after every refit too?
